summary: Implemented split_amount in ledger/split.py following docs/CONVENTIONS.md: integer cents, conserving total, leftover cents to earliest parties, refunds split on absolute value and negated, ValueError for non-positive party counts. Added tests covering uneven splits, refunds, zero totals and invalid counts.
assumptions: Amounts are integer cents per docs/CONVENTIONS.md, so split_amount(1000, 3) means $10.00 split three ways and returns [334, 333, 333].
Non-integer inputs (floats, bools) raise TypeError, since floats are never used for money.
A zero total is valid and yields a list of zeros, one per party.
